note: Legend portraits, the knight (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Squire
legends.subject: a medieval squire, a lean boy with a bowl haircut and an eager face, a padded gambeson, polishing a mail hauberk, a stable behind him.

legends.name: Bedivere
legends.subject: Sir Bedivere of the Round Table, a weary loyal knight with a short grey beard, dented mail and a white surcoat, a dark still lake at dawn behind him.

legends.name: Gawain
legends.source: Arthurian legend (Sir Gawain and the Green Knight)
legends.subject: Sir Gawain, a courteous handsome knight with red-gold hair, a mail hauberk and a red surcoat with a gold pentangle, bright noon sun behind him.

legends.name: Roland
legends.subject: Roland the paladin of the Song of Roland, a young knight with a noble proud face, a conical nasal helmet and mail, an ivory horn at his lips, a mountain pass behind him.

legends.name: El Cid
legends.subject: El Cid, the Castilian lord of the old epic, a bearded knight with a long flowing beard, a nasal helmet and mail, a white cloak, the walls of Valencia behind him.

legends.name: Lancelot
legends.subject: Sir Lancelot du Lac, a dark-haired knight with a noble sorrowful face, polished mail and a white shield with three red bends, a castle hall behind him.

legends.name: Siegfried
legends.subject: Siegfried the dragon-slayer of the Nibelungenlied, a tall fair-haired young hero, a linden leaf falling on his shoulder, a dark dragon's cave behind him.

legends.name: Hector
legends.subject: Hector prince of Troy, a bearded warrior in a tall bronze helmet with a horsehair crest, a bronze cuirass, the walls of Troy behind him.

legends.name: Achilles
legends.subject: Achilles of the Iliad, a young fierce warrior with long golden hair, a gleaming bronze helmet and cuirass made by a god, rage in his eyes, a burning Trojan plain behind him.

legends.name: Thor
legends.subject: Thor the Norse thunder god, a huge red-bearded man with fierce eyes, iron gauntlets, the short-handled hammer Mjolnir, a thunderstorm sky behind him.
